evals.prompt: Create a Hedera Agent Kit mutation tool class that transfers HBAR between accounts. Include the Zod parameter schema and BaseTool lifecycle methods.
evals.expected_output: A TypeScript tool class extending BaseTool with z.object parameters, normalizeParams, coreAction, and secondaryAction.

checks.name: uses-zod-schema
checks.description: Defines parameters with a Zod object schema

checks.name: defines-method-suffix
checks.description: Uses snake_case method name ending in _tool
checks.rubric: The output defines a tool method identifier in snake_case ending with _tool

checks.name: implements-secondary-action
checks.description: Implements secondaryAction for mutation submit flow

evals.prompt: Show me the plugin index.ts structure for a custom Hedera Agent Kit plugin with one query tool that reads token info from the mirror node.
evals.expected_output: A Plugin export with name, tools factory returning BaseTool instances, and shouldSecondaryAction disabled for the query tool.

checks.name: tools-factory
checks.description: Defines a tools factory on the plugin

checks.name: query-tool-pattern
checks.description: Uses shouldSecondaryAction for a read-only query tool
checks.rubric: The output shows a query tool pattern that skips secondaryAction (for example shouldSecondaryAction returning false)

checks.name: exports-tool-names
checks.description: Exports tool name constants for registration
checks.rubric: The output exports tool name constants (for example a ToolNames map or UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constant)
